:::{#sol-transpose-sum-practice}

Adding entry by entry,

$$
\matr{A} + \matr{B} = \sbmat{1 & 3 & 1 \\ 5 & 1 & 1},
$$

so

$$
\tp{(\matr{A} + \matr{B})} = \sbmat{1 & 5 \\ 3 & 1 \\ 1 & 1}.
$$

By @thm-transpose-sum,
adding $\tp{\matr{A}} = \sbmat{1 & 3 \\ 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 4}$ and $\tp{\matr{B}} = \sbmat{0 & 2 \\ 1 & 2 \\ 1 & -3}$
gives the same [matrix](#def-matrix).

:::
